title: DC-area forecast: Less humid today, storm chances return tomorrow
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Plenty of sun heats us up to afternoon highs in the upper 80s to near 90, but it's a somewhat comfortable heat with lower humidity.

What’s next? Humidity and storm chances make a quick comeback tomorrow, with both sticking around through at least Saturday. The Sunday forecast is a tricky one.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: Finally, a noticeable drop in humidity! Still kind of hot, though, so don't want to score it much higher than that. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Wednesday): Mostly sunny and kind of hot, with highs in the upper 80s to near 90. But it's noticeably less humid with dew points in the low to mid-60s. Winds are light from the northwest and west around 5 to 10 mph. Confidence: High

Tonight: Fairly comfortable this evening although humidity is already increasing again by overnight. Increasing clouds as well overnight with lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Thursday): Partly sunny with afternoon highs in the mid- to upper 80s. The humidity is back with dew points up around 70 again, and so is a chance of scattered showers and storms during the afternoon into evening. An isolated storm could have strong winds, especially south of DC. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers and storms may continue into the evening, then lower rain chances overnight. Skies are mostly cloudy with lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Partly sunny Friday and partly to mostly cloudy Saturday. Both days should see a bit cooler highs in the upper 70s to mid-80s with a continued chance of scattered showers and storms, mainly during the afternoon into evening. Humidity should be in the moderate to high range. Friday and Saturday night lows in the upper 60s to low 70s. Confidence: Low-Medium

Sunday is one of those tricky transition days. It's uncertain at this point if a cold front will linger nearby, keeping clouds and higher humidity and a chance of showers around, or if the front will make it far enough to our south for a brighter and drier day with lower humidity. Highs are probably in the upper 70s to mid-80s again. Confidence: Low

Monday, the first day of school for some, is looking more confidently dry with lower humidity. Highs aim for the low to mid-80s. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for August 19

Remnants of Hurricane Camille in 1969 brought modest rain to DC but unleashed catastrophic flooding in Virginia, causing one of the deadliest natural disasters in the state’s history.
